scope: Circulation module: librarian issues a book, then returns that loan. Shared records: books.available, transactions.status/due_date, fines. Supporting fine settlement is unit-tested; unrelated administration, Gemini, mail and uploads are excluded from functional scope.
roles: May issue and return books through the protected circulation endpoints.
May use student functions but receives HTTP 403 for issue and return actions.
useCaseOwnership: UC1 Issue book; UC2 Return book
UC3 Eligibility check; UC4 Overdue fine
UC5 Stock allocation; UC6 Correct loan selection
assumptions: A member may hold at most one active loan per ISBN; repeated issue requests must not duplicate that loan (brief's no-duplicates requirement).
Only ISSUED transactions can transition to RETURNED. LOST requires an explicit separate recovery policy, absent upstream.
Book stock and transaction updates must commit atomically; audit failure is treated as a transaction failure.
Database column limits define input length limits where DTO validation is absent. Spec describes the desired contract and identifies observed differences.
The reproducible test environment pins Java to Asia/Karachi and MySQL sessions to +05:00. No historical weekly work is claimed.
requirements: Reject at 3 active loans and above
Create one loan, decrement one copy, due in 14 days
Repeat issue creates no duplicate active loan
Restore one copy and record return date/operator
No fine before/on due date; overdue creates days times category rate
Failure leaves persisted state unchanged; retry writes once
rules: Eligible = active AND available>0 AND count<3 AND no outstanding fine. MCC: all 16 combinations; only 1111 allows. MC/DC pairs: 15/7,15/11,15/13,15/14.
Issue atomically writes ISSUED loan, due today+14, and available-1; duplicate member+ISBN active loan is forbidden.
ISSUED -> RETURNED only; RETURNED and LOST returns rejected without stock change.
Overdue=max(0,returnDate-dueDate). Fine=overdue*categoryRate; paid OR waived blocks a second settlement. MCC paid/waived: 00 permits,01/10/11 reject; MC/DC 00/01 and 00/10.
risks: Cross-workflow SQL assertions, rollback, concurrency review
Repeat request regression; concurrent repeats remain a risk
All return source states, before/after regression
Date BVA, category rates, settlement MCC
Real MySQL rollback and recovery test
Prepare local CI/issues/PR text; disclose absent remote evidence
Prioritise high-risk workflows; record incomplete activities honestly
exitCriteria: FR01-FR12 automated assertions pass; no open critical/high state-integrity defect
100% line and branch coverage of the selected IssueReturnService and FineService; PIT >=80%; both custom mutants killed
Each 1-VU/5-VU run p95<=500ms and unexpected failures<1%; no critical/serious axe finding on repaired screen
plan: Risk 20-25: full positive/negative/state/rollback/role coverage. Risk 12-16: boundaries, partitions and decisions. Entry: build starts, isolated MySQL and synthetic data ready. Suspend on unavailable database, corrupted seed or unsafe environment; resume only after seed and health checks. Exit uses EC1-EC3. Named area and use-case ownership is recorded; automation authorship remains disclosed and is not attributed to students.

Metrics: requirements exercised/12 (not equal to pass rate); defects per KLOC using Sonar ncloc; reopened defects/previously closed defects (N/A without lifecycle history); line/branch coverage; PIT score; browser/API failure rate; release criteria actual vs target.
